wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 07-002 aggregates the menu state machine (createMenuState, openMenu, closeMenu, openMessage, tickMenu, handleMenuKey, mouse/joy gating) and the HU-font lump-name resolver (huFontLumpName) into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for the menu-overlay composition pass. The read-only src/ui/menus.ts and src/ui/assets.ts already implement vanilla m_menu.c / hu_stuff.c semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification. Unblocked by the e365561 prereq-cycle fix chain.
